import { 
  Group, 
  Mesh, 
  PlaneGeometry, 
  BoxGeometry,
  Vector3, 
  Color,
  MeshStandardNodeMaterial, 
  MeshBasicNodeMaterial,
  DirectionalLight, 
  AmbientLight
} from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec2, mix, uniform } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { THREE } = ctx;
  const mainGroup = new Group();

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 1. CONFIG & PALETTE
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    background: "#0b0b10",
    surface: "#14141a",
    ink: "#16161d",
    paper: "#e8ecf2",
    accent: "#ff2a38",
    gradientStops: [{ at: 0, hex: "#0b0b10" }, { at: 1, hex: "#12121a" }]
  };

  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const headlineText = textItems.find(t => t.role === 'headline')?.text ?? "The collection";
  const bodyText = textItems.find(t => t.role === 'body')?.text ?? "Five calibres. One discipline.";
  const captions = textItems.filter(t => t.role === 'caption').map(t => t.text);

  // Fallbacks if not enough captions
  while (captions.length < 5) {
    captions.push(`NA-0${captions.length + 1} CALIBRE`);
  }

  // Active state tracking
  let activeIndex = 0;
  const numCards = 5;
  const cardWidth = 1.6;
  const cardHeight = 1.0;
  const pitch = 1.85;
  const stripBaseYRotation = -18 * (Math.PI / 180);

  // Keep track of cleanup resources
  const disposables = [];
  const activeTimelines = [];

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 2. STAGE BACKDROP & LIGHTING
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // Custom NodeMaterial for vertical gradient
  const bgGeom = new PlaneGeometry(12, 8);
  disposables.push(bgGeom);

  const topColorUniform = uniform(new Color(colors.gradientStops[0].hex));
  const bottomColorUniform = uniform(new Color(colors.gradientStops[1].hex));
  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  bgMat.colorNode = mix(bottomColorUniform, topColorUniform, uv().y);
  bgMat.depthWrite = false;
  
  const backdrop = new Mesh(bgGeom, bgMat);
  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  mainGroup.add(backdrop);

  // local lights for studio look
  const keyLight = new DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
  keyLight.position.set(3, 4, 5);
  mainGroup.add(keyLight);

  const rimLight = new DirectionalLight(colors.accent, 0.8);
  rimLight.position.set(-4, -2, -1);
  mainGroup.add(rimLight);

  const localAmbient = new AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.3);
  mainGroup.add(localAmbient);

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 3. STATICS: HEADLINE & BODY Pinned
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  const headlineNode = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(headlineText, {
    fontSize: 48,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'left'
  });
  headlineNode.position.set(-2.8, 1.8, 0.1);
  mainGroup.add(headlineNode);

  const bodyNode = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(bodyText, {
    fontSize: 18,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'left'
  });
  bodyNode.position.set(-2.8, -1.8, 0.1);
  mainGroup.add(bodyNode);

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 4. THE FILMSTRIP CAROUSEL
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  const stripGroup = new Group();
  // Align strip angle
  stripGroup.rotation.y = stripBaseYRotation;
  mainGroup.add(stripGroup);

  const cardsArray = [];

  // Geometry shared by picture frames
  const imageGeom = new PlaneGeometry(cardWidth, cardHeight);
  const frameGeom = new BoxGeometry(cardWidth + 0.05, cardHeight + 0.05, 0.03);
  const lineGeom = new PlaneGeometry(cardWidth, 0.035);
  disposables.push(imageGeom, frameGeom, lineGeom);

  // Load Main Texture
  const uvOffsets = [
    vec2(0.0, 0.0),
    vec2(0.2, 0.1),
    vec2(0.4, 0.3),
    vec2(0.1, 0.5),
    vec2(0.3, 0.2)
  ];

  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((texture) => {
    texture.colorSpace = 'srgb';
    
    for (let i = 0; i < numCards; i++) {
      const cardContainer = new Group();
      cardContainer.position.x = (i - activeIndex) * pitch;

      // Unique NodeMaterial per card with parallax logic
      const cardMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
        roughness: 0.55,
        metalness: 0.2,
        clearcoat: 0.15,
        transparent: true
      });

      // Handle custom parallax UV shifting via NodeMaterial uniforms
      const uvOffset = uniform(uvOffsets[i]);
      const parallaxShift = uniform(vec2(0, 0));
      
      cardMat.colorNode = cardMat.sampleTexture(
        texture, 
        uv().multiply(0.6).add(uvOffset).add(parallaxShift)
      );

      const pictureMesh = new Mesh(imageGeom, cardMat);
      pictureMesh.position.z = 0.02;
      cardContainer.add(pictureMesh);

      // Framed by machined dark bevel
      const frameMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
        color: colors.ink,
        roughness: 0.7,
        metalness: 0.8
      });
      const frameMesh = new Mesh(frameGeom, frameMat);
      cardContainer.add(frameMesh);

      // Red active underline
      const lineMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
        color: colors.accent,
        emissive: colors.accent,
        emissiveIntensity: 1.3,
        transparent: true
      });
      const underlineMesh = new Mesh(lineGeom, lineMat);
      underlineMesh.position.set(0, -0.6, 0.03);
      cardContainer.add(underlineMesh);

      // Caption
      const textContainer = new Group();
      textContainer.position.set(0, -0.85, 0.03);
      const captionNode = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(captions[i], {
        fontSize: 14,
        color: colors.paper,
        align: 'center'
      });
      textContainer.add(captionNode);
      cardContainer.add(textContainer);

      stripGroup.add(cardContainer);

      cardsArray.push({
        container: cardContainer,
        picture: pictureMesh,
        underline: underlineMesh,
        caption: textContainer,
        parallaxShift: parallaxShift,
        index: i
      });
    }

    updateCardsLayout(true);
  });

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 5. ANIMATION & TRANSITION SYSTEM
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  function updateCardsLayout(immediate = false) {
    cardsArray.forEach((card) => {
      const distance = card.index - activeIndex;
      
      // Calculate depth properties based on active focus
      const isFocused = card.index === activeIndex;
      const targetScale = isFocused ? 1.0 : 0.92;
      const targetOpacity = isFocused ? 1.0 : gsap.utils.clamp(0.1, 1.0, 1.0 - Math.abs(distance) * 0.22);
      
      // Counter-rotate active card to face dead-on (negate the parent's default rotation)
      const targetYRotation = isFocused ? -stripBaseYRotation : 0;
      const targetX = distance * pitch;

      // Parallax shift calculation based on position
      const parallaxValX = -distance * 0.04;

      if (immediate) {
        card.container.position.x = targetX;
        card.container.scale.setScalar(targetScale);
        card.container.rotation.y = targetYRotation;
        card.underline.scale.x = isFocused ? 1 : 0.001;
        card.underline.material.opacity = isFocused ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        card.caption.position.y = isFocused ? -0.85 : -1.0;
        card.caption.children[0].alpha = isFocused ? 1.0 : 0.2; 
        card.parallaxShift.value.x = parallaxValX;
      } else {
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        activeTimelines.push(tl);

        // Weighted-settle animation (overshoot 1.04 -> 1)
        tl.to(card.container.position, {
          x: targetX,
          duration: 0.9,
          ease: "power4.out"
        }, 0);

        tl.to(card.container.rotation, {
          y: targetYRotation,
          duration: 0.9,
          ease: "power3.out"
        }, 0);

        tl.to(card.container.scale, {
          x: targetScale,
          y: targetScale,
          z: targetScale,
          duration: 0.9,
          ease: "back.out(1.04)"
        }, 0);

        tl.to(card.underline.scale, {
          x: isFocused ? 1 : 0.001,
          duration: 0.6,
          ease: "power2.out"
        }, 0);

        tl.to(card.underline.material, {
          opacity: isFocused ? 1.0 : 0.0,
          duration: 0.5
        }, 0);

        tl.to(card.caption.position, {
          y: isFocused ? -0.85 : -1.1,
          duration: 0.7,
          ease: "power3.out"
        }, 0);

        tl.to(card.parallaxShift.value, {
          x: parallaxValX,
          duration: 0.9,
          ease: "power2.out"
        }, 0);
      }
    });
  }

  // Bind custom logic for navigating / scrolling
  const handleScroll = (delta) => {
    const prevIndex = activeIndex;
    if (delta > 0) {
      activeIndex = Math.min(numCards - 1, activeIndex + 1);
    } else {
      activeIndex = Math.max(0, activeIndex - 1);
    }
    if (prevIndex !== activeIndex) {
      updateCardsLayout();
    }
  };

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 6. EVENT INTERACTION
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // Expose primitive configurations
  if (config.cinematicPrimitives) {
    config.cinematicPrimitives.forEach((prim) => {
      if (ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
        const outcome = ctx.primitives[prim.name](mainGroup, prim.params);
        if (outcome?.cleanup) {
          disposables.push({ dispose: outcome.cleanup });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Attach manual scroll trigger to userData for core host environment integration
  mainGroup.userData.handlers = {
    onWheel: (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      handleScroll(event.deltaY);
    },
    onClick: (event) => {
      // Allow clicking sides to slide
      if (event.clientX > window.innerWidth / 2) {
        handleScroll(1);
      } else {
        handleScroll(-1);
      }
    }
  };

  // Cleanup handler
  mainGroup.userData.cleanup = () => {
    activeTimelines.forEach(tl => tl.kill());
    disposables.forEach((item) => {
      if (typeof item.dispose === 'function') {
        item.dispose();
      }
    });
  };

  return mainGroup;
}
